name: Amanatides-Woo Voxel Traversal
aliases: Amanatides-Woo Voxel Traversal — DDA Voxel Traversal, Digital Differential Analyzer, Ray traversal, Ray-traversal for 3D particle matching, Voxel Raycasting, Voxel-based ray matching
Voxel traversal by Amanatides and Woo
definition: A ray traversal algorithm for sparse voxel grids that steps through voxels along the ray's path by advancing to the nearest voxel boundary on the axis with the smallest t-value.
